scope: Exact high-byte-slice/shift guard matching versus the clean integrated probe parent; all prior highslice captures are correctness research, no timing samples have been collected.
criterion: Every CPU/wall ratio-of-medians and simultaneous upper mean-ratio bootstrap bound <=5 percent. One final look; no unchanged-code repeat.
execution: Eight comparisons on disjoint physical CPU pairs;384 paired rounds, balanced randomized order, no own builds/tests/captures/backends overlap.

lightwork_reservation_amendment.reason: Reserve a physical pair for light work; exclude it from workers before samples.

failure_policy: Retain every observation. A failed bound does not authorize a repeat of unchanged code or publication as a default-on improvement. Diagnose material cost and improve the implementation or introduce an opt-in option before publication.
build_binding: Record final binary and source hashes after parent integration, all gates, complete breadth review, and native proofs, before sampling.

dependency_amendment.reason: Land the independent Rust empty-match correction first. Re-anchor the high-slice guard and validate complete outputs against that matching parent before sampling.
dependency_amendment.new_parent_binding: The committed, merged empty-match head and binary; resolved by prepare.py.

build.parent_artifact_provenance: Clean committed and locally validated empty-match dependency; publication is held until its PR merges; its independently validated release build and frozen154specs are reused.
